items.why: Crude extended its rally after the WSJ reported oil hit a five-month high, with TheStreet flagging it as a key market driver Friday morning.
MarketWatch reported the Nasdaq gained as tech stocks bounced while the Dow and S&P fell, and AMD rode the tech rebound.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.
The Dow opened lower per the WSJ, with MarketWatch noting the Dow and S&P fell even as tech bounced.

market_note: Split tape: Dow and S&P lower, Nasdaq futures green, oil up again, gold softer.
summary: Friday is a tale of two markets: the Dow and S&P are falling while the Nasdaq bounces higher on tech strength. Oil extended its five-month high run and gold gave back ground.
